stem.en: English ___ in many countries around the world.

why.en: The language does not speak; people speak it. So we need the passive: is + past participle.
why.uz: Til oʻzi gapirmaydi, uni odamlar gapiradi. Shuning uchun majhul nisbat: is + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: Язык сам не говорит, на нём говорят люди. Поэтому пассив: is + третья форма.

why.en: Someone built the bridge in the past: past simple passive, was + past participle.
why.uz: Koʻprikni kimdir oʻtmishda qurgan: Past Simple majhul nisbati, was + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: Мост кто-то построил в прошлом: пассив Past Simple, was + третья форма.

stem.en: Our classroom ___ every evening by the cleaners.

why.en: By the cleaners shows who does the action, so the classroom gets the passive: is cleaned.
why.uz: By the cleaners harakatni kim bajarishini koʻrsatadi, shuning uchun majhul nisbat: is cleaned.
why.ru: By the cleaners показывает, кто выполняет действие, поэтому пассив: is cleaned.

stem.en: Were these photos ___ by your father?

why.en: A passive question is were + subject + past participle: were these photos taken?
why.uz: Majhul nisbatdagi savol: were + ega + uchinchi shakl: were these photos taken?
why.ru: Вопрос в пассиве: were + подлежащее + третья форма: were these photos taken?

stem.en: If I ___ a lot of money, I would travel around the world.

why.en: An imagined situation now: if + past simple (had), would in the other part.
why.uz: Hozirgi xayoliy vaziyat: if + Past Simple (had), ikkinchi qismda would.
why.ru: Воображаемая ситуация сейчас: if + Past Simple (had), в другой части would.

stem.en: If she lived closer, she ___ us more often.

why.en: If + past simple (lived) takes would + the base verb in the result: would visit.
why.uz: If + Past Simple (lived) boʻlsa, natija qismida would + asosiy shakl: would visit.
why.ru: При if + Past Simple (lived) в результате would + начальная форма: would visit.

stem.en: What would you do if you ___ a famous person in the street?

why.en: With would in the main part, the if-part uses the past simple: if you met.
why.uz: Asosiy qismda would boʻlsa, if qismi Past Simple da: if you met.
why.ru: Если в главной части would, то в части с if — Past Simple: if you met.

If I know the answer, I'd tell you.
If I'd know the answer, I'd tell you.
If I knew the answer, I'll tell you.

why.en: Second conditional: if + past simple (knew) and would (I'd) in the other part.
why.uz: Ikkinchi tur shart gap: if + Past Simple (knew) va ikkinchi qismda would (I'd).
why.ru: Условное второго типа: if + Past Simple (knew) и would (I'd) в другой части.

stem.en: "We will help you," they said. → They said they ___ help me.

why.en: In reported speech after said, will usually changes to would: they said they would help.
why.uz: Said dan keyingi oʻzlashtirma gapda will odatda would ga oʻzgaradi: they said they would help.
why.ru: В косвенной речи после said will обычно меняется на would: they said they would help.

why.en: A reported question uses normal word order (subject + verb) and no did: where I lived.
why.uz: Oʻzlashtirma soʻroq gapda oddiy tartib (ega + feʼl) ishlatiladi, did kerak emas: where I lived.
why.ru: В косвенном вопросе прямой порядок слов (подлежащее + глагол) и без did: where I lived.

stem.en: The teacher told us ___ during the test.

why.en: A reported order not to do something: told + person + not to + verb.
why.uz: Biror narsani qilmaslik haqidagi buyruq oʻzlashtirilganda: told + kishi + not to + feʼl.
why.ru: Переданный приказ чего-то не делать: told + человек + not to + глагол.

stem.en: He said he ___ the film the week before.

why.en: The week before refers to an earlier past in reported speech: had seen.
why.uz: Oʻzlashtirma gapda the week before oldingi oʻtmishni bildiradi: had seen.
why.ru: В косвенной речи the week before указывает на более раннее прошлое: had seen.

stem.en: That ___ be Rustam at the door. He's in London this week.

why.en: We are sure it is not true (he is in London), so we use can't + be.
why.uz: Bu rost emasligiga ishonchimiz komil (u Londonda), shuning uchun can't + be.
why.ru: Мы уверены, что это не так (он в Лондоне), поэтому can't + be.

stem.en: Kamola has been working all day. She ___ be very tired.

why.en: We are almost sure this is true because of the evidence, so we use must + be.
why.uz: Dalilga koʻra bu rost ekaniga deyarli ishonamiz, shuning uchun must + be.
why.ru: Мы почти уверены в этом по фактам, поэтому must + be.

stem.en: I'm not sure where Timur is. He ___ be in the library.

why.en: Not sure means only a possibility, so we use might + be.
why.uz: Not sure faqat ehtimolni bildiradi, shuning uchun might + be.
why.ru: Not sure означает лишь возможность, поэтому might + be.

stem.en: Whose coat is this? — It ___ be Malika's. It's her favourite colour.

why.en: The colour is a reason to think it is possible, so we use could + be.
why.uz: Rang bu mumkinligiga asos boʻladi, shuning uchun could + be.
why.ru: Цвет — повод считать это возможным, поэтому could + be.
